definitions.f: eccSet(G,B) = max_v min_{b in B} dist(v,b)
definitions.q3_integer_form: EXISTS induced girth-cycle K, EXISTS x: d(x,V(K)) >= f - floor(girth/3) + 1
definitions.q3_bridge: t >= girth - 1 + d(x,V(K)); with q3 gives t >= f + ceil(2*girth/3) >= f + (2/3)*girth
definitions.q4: for EVERY diametral geodesic P, every x: t >= (diam+1) + d(x,V(P))
definitions.q5: for f-realizing x*: EXISTS diametral geodesic P with d(x*,V(P)) >= (2/3)*girth + f - diam - 1
